scientific_integrity: An analytical argument establishes the norm limit and boundary-layer location; exact polynomial identities and finite numerical experiments are supplementary checks, not proofs of infinite limits. Earlier unindexed equivalent asymptotics remain an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real \(0<q<1\) only; exact unclipped unnormalized one-dimensional kernel. No joint q to 1 uniformity, empirical weight clipping, classifier performance or independent validation is established.
title: Sharp uniform degree truncation of the discrete \(q\)-Hermite kernel
